claims: Colorado's ban on conversion therapy was overturned based on a 31 March 2026 Supreme Court ruling.
HB19-1129 barred licensed psychiatrists and mental health providers from attempting to change a patient under 18 years old’s sexual orientation or gender identity.
HB19-1129 targeted sexual orientation and gender identity change efforts (SOGICE).
Colorado's conversion therapy ban applied only to state-licensed professionals.
Colorado's conversion therapy ban did not apply to religious counselors.
Colorado's conversion therapy ban did not apply to parents.
On 31 March 2026, the Supreme Court sided with a Colorado counselor.
The Supreme Court ruled that Colorado's conversion therapy ban restricted free speech.
The Supreme Court ruling effectively overturned Colorado’s prohibition on conversion therapy.
The American Psychological Association considers conversion therapy dangerous and ineffective.
The Alliance Defending Freedom represented religious counselors who challenged the ban.
